hero.title: Does your CV <underline>actually fit</underline> the job?
hero.lede: Paste the posting, upload your CV, and get a frank read of your own application: what matches, what's missing, and what to fix first. Then practice the interview out loud with an AI interviewer.

how.title: Three steps. About a minute.
how.aside: Runs while you wait. Sign in and go.

paste.title: Paste the job
paste.body: Company, title and the full description, straight from the posting. That is the yardstick everything gets measured against.

upload.title: Upload your CV
upload.body: One PDF. We read its text layer and compare it with the job, requirement by requirement.

verdict.title: Get the verdict
verdict.body: A fit score, six scored dimensions and the fixes that move the needle most. Then rehearse the interview for that same job.

dimensions.title: Six readings, one verdict.
dimensions.lede: Each dimension gets its own score, its evidence, and the concrete changes that would raise it. The global fit score is the headline; these are the reasons.

ats.name: ATS compatibility
ats.body: Whether an applicant tracking system can parse it at all: section headers, dates, structure.

experience.name: Experience & impact
experience.body: Do your bullets show outcomes and scope, or only duties? Suggested rewrites included.

skills.name: Skills
skills.body: Which required skills you prove with evidence, which you only name, and which are missing.

education.name: Education & certifications
education.body: What counts for this role and what would be worth adding.

tone.name: Tone & clarity
tone.body: Readability, tense, jargon, and how fast a reader gets the point.

jobFit.name: Job fit
jobFit.body: Keyword and requirement overlap with this specific posting, plus the strategic moves.

interview.title: Rehearse the interview before the real one.
interview.lede: An AI voice interviewer built from the same job post asks the questions that posting invites, and digs into the gaps your analysis found. You answer out loud, on your laptop or your phone. When you end the call, you get a score on five things, how each gap went in your own words, and the transcript. It is practice, for you: nobody else hears it.

finalCta.title: Your next application deserves a second opinion.
